purpose: Approved supplier and vendor logo library for the TCN products page.
usage: Each supplier record in catalogue-data.js carries a logoKey. The visible fallback is logo-placeholder.svg. Add an approved local SVG or PNG here, then replace that key's src in assets/asset-library.js. The products page automatically renders the approved logo in the same fixed slot.
status: All suppliers currently use the clearly marked placeholder tile. Obtain the applicable brand-use approval before adding an official vendor logo.

assets.purpose: Shared visible fallback for supplier cards until an approved vendor logo is supplied.
